newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo Energy adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Energy adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said Thursday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.
The company said under the plan it declared a dividend of one right for each outstanding share of Nuevo common stock held as of March 21. The rights distributed are to expire on March 21, 2007.
Nuevo said the plan was not adopted in response to any takeover attempt.

"However, with the recent decline in Nuevo's share price and its attractive valuation in today's marketplace, we wanted to ensure that all shareholders of the company receive equal treatment and a fair valuation for their common stock in the event of a proposed takeover," President and Chief Executive Mike Watford said in a statement.
Earlier, Nuevo said its board had approved the repurchase of up to 1 million common shares in open market transactions during the remainder of 1997.
The repurchase of 1 million shares would represent 5 percent of the 20.1 million shares outstanding as of March 5.
